metadata.title: Urban Interior Illustration with Bubble Lettering

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized urban interior scene featuring a group of figures in relaxed poses, characterized by a warm, earthy color palette and prominent graffiti-inspired bubble typography. The artwork uses a painterly, airbrushed texture with high-contrast lighting to create depth within a cluttered, lived-in space.
coreVisualRelationships: The large bubble lettering at the top and bottom frames the central group of figures.
Warm interior lighting contrasts with the dark, silhouetted city view through the window.
The diagonal lines of the furniture and floor lead the eye toward the seated group.
The orange and red tones of the text echo the warm highlights on the figures' clothing.
coreInvariants: Hand-drawn bubble lettering with thick black outlines
A palette dominated by burnt sienna, ochre, and deep brown
Urban setting elements like radiators and city-view windows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of four men occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, with one figure scaled larger in the foreground left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright white t-shirt of the foreground figure serves as the primary light anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-center lettering, moves down the left figure, across the couch to the right, and finishes at the bottom-right lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is dense with interior details and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks provide the structural shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white on clothing and sneakers provides sharp focal points.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and red are reserved for the large-scale typography and wall art.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark shadows and bright highlights; saturation is concentrated in the graphic text elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and primary-adjacent warm accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, rounded sans-serif with overlapping characters
letterConstructionRules: Extreme weight with almost no counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are squeezed horizontally to fit the frame width
Bottom edges of letters are often flattened or curved to follow a baseline arc
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The two text blocks use the same custom style to create a visual frame for the central image.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the street-art influence of the original lettering
Captures the soft, rounded volume of the glyphs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed-style illustration of an urban apartment interior at night. Include a group of men in 90s streetwear (white tees, baggy jeans, beanies) lounging on a dark leather sofa. Use warm, high-contrast lighting from an unseen source. Include a window showing a dark city silhouette and a radiator in the background. Leave clear space at the top center and bottom right for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom bubble-style lettering in orange with a thick black outline. The top text should be slightly arched; the bottom text should be staggered in the lower right corner. Ensure letters overlap significantly.

verificationChecks: Is the lettering thick and rounded with heavy outlines?
Does the lighting create high contrast on the figures?
Is the color palette dominated by warm earth tones?
Are the figures in relaxed, naturalistic poses?

adjustableVariables: Specific poses of the background figures
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
Exact graffiti tags on the wall art
The specific portrait on the left wall
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the primary figure's face.
Ensure the white clothing doesn't blow out and maintains some texture.
Verify the bubble letters feel voluminous rather than flat.
Confirm the background city view is dark enough to provide contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Interior + Airbrush Texture + High Contrast Warm Lighting + Bubble Lettering Overlay
